newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Aluminium Bahrain mandates banks for $85 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium Bahrain mandates banks for $85 mln loan.

text.p: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba), the Middle East's biggest aluminium producer, said on Thursday it had mandated five Bahrain-based banks for an $85 million loan facility to finance expansion projects.

A company statement said Gulf International Bank, Chase Manhattan Bank, ABN Amro, Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait and Al-Ahli Commercial Bank had been awarded the mandate for the seven-year syndicated loan.
It said $28 million would be used to enhance one of the smelter's casthouses, $24 million to build a new liquid pitch facility and $33 million for a power project.
Work had already started at the $24 million liquid pitch terminal which is being built alongside existing facilities handling alumina and petroleum coke.
The Bahraini government owns 77 percent of Alba and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund holds 20 percent. German group Breton Investments owns three percent. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424.
